scope: development, not formal holdout; resident original-KV selection only
fixed_resource: eligible resident historical logical attention-pair cap
shared_selection: one token subset across all heads; aggregate scores after nonlinear query/head scoring
proxy_normalization: eligible committed history summaries only, not full Attention
contrast_reference: query-conditioned mixture of the eligible V means
summary_update: new clean K/V, commit after complete generator call; no teacher inputs
reuse: within current chunk denoising only; clean call recomputes; no Q/K/V/output caching
positions: preserve original absolute post-RoPE K exactly
teacher: actual output after deleting/replacing original inputs and renormalizing independently
known_limit: full native window preparation and resident KV storage remain; no claimed CPU archive or H2D savings
